verdict.rationale: Plaid is an API platform, so scoped or least-privilege credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only says developers receive API keys from the Dashboard and that a Dashboard MCP server exists. Nothing documents scoping keys by permission, product, or read-only access, or issuing restricted credentials to an agent. Per-product data access through Link concerns end-user consent, not API credential scoping, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
